name: CData Connect AI
description: Connect Claude to read, write, and act on 350+ enterprise data sources like Salesforce, Snowflake and NetSuite in real-time through one fully hosted remote MCP server. Connect AI is the only managed MCP platform built with semantic intelligence that understands your data's metadata and relationships across systems for multi-source analysis. Ensure trusted boundaries with enterprise security, granular permissions, and complete audit trails. Set up any source in minutes and get started free.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CData Connect AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CData Connect AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cloud.cdata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CData Connect AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CData Connect AI provides these MCP tools: getTables, getSchemas, getProcedures, getProcedureParameters, getPrimaryKeys, getIndexes, getImportedKeys, getExportedKeys, getColumns, getCatalogs, execData, and queryData.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CData Connect AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CData Connect AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does CData Connect AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CData Connect AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CData Connect AI is developed by CData. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
